AGENT_NOT_FOUND: This agent no longer exists, or isn't shared with you.
AGENT_EDIT_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this agent while you were editing. Review their changes or keep yours.
AGENT_NOT_EDITABLE: This agent is archived or deleted, so it can't be edited. Restore it first.
AGENT_NOT_READY: This agent isn't ready to publish. Fix the items marked as required.
AGENT_PAUSED: This agent is paused and isn't answering right now.
AGENT_STATE_INVALID: This agent can't do that in its current state.
AGENT_NOT_PUBLISHED: This agent hasn't been published yet.
AGENT_MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_AUDIENCE: The agent's model isn't allowed for everyone it's shared with. Choose another model or ask an admin.
AGENT_CHANNEL_EXISTS: This agent already has a channel of that type.
AGENT_CHANNEL_PENDING_APPROVAL: This channel is waiting for an admin's approval and can't be changed yet.
AGENT_TOOL_HTTP_ERROR: The address answered with an error. Check the URL, the method and the arguments.
AGENT_TOOL_BAD_RESPONSE: The answer wasn't what this tool expects. Check that the address is the right one.
AGENT_WIDGET_TOKEN_INVALID: This chat isn't set up correctly. Ask the site owner to update the widget code.
AGENT_WIDGET_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This chat isn't allowed on this website. Ask the site owner to add it in the agent's Publish tab.
AGENT_CHANNEL_SIGNATURE_INVALID: This message could not be checked, so it was not answered. Check the app's signing secret.
AGENT_CHANNEL_VERIFY_TOKEN_INVALID: The verify token doesn't match. Copy it again from the agent's Publish tab.
AGENT_CHANNEL_ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account already answers for another agent. Remove it there first, or use another account.
